title: Ganesha
description: I have an elephant's head, a big heart, and a special place at the beginning of every new journey. People seek my blessings for wisdom, good fortune, and help overcoming obstacles.
hint: My favorite sweet is the modak, and my vehicle is a mouse.

title: Buddha
description: I left behind a life of luxury to search for the meaning of life. Through meditation, I discovered a path to peace, compassion, and freedom from suffering.
hint: I attained enlightenment under a Bodhi tree.

title: Krishna
description: I am playful, charming, and wise. I love music, especially the sound of my flute, and I share lessons about love, duty, and devotion.
hint: My crown often features a peacock feather.

title: Rama, Sita, Lakshmana and Hanuman
description: This family’s return to Ayodhya after 14 years in exile was celebrated with rows of oil lamps. This homecoming is the reason Diwali is celebrated in much of North India.
hint: Their story is told in the Ramayana.
answer: Lord Rama, Goddess Sita, Lakshmana and Hanuman

title: Radha and Krishna on a Boat
description: These two are enjoying a boat ride together. One is known for playing the flute, and the other is his beloved. Their story is celebrated in songs, dances, and festivals across India.
hint: One wears a peacock feather in his crown, and the other is named Radha.
answer: Radha and Krishna on a boat

title: Sai Baba
description: I look like a calm, elderly man in simple clothes rather than a traditional, heavily decorated deity. People from different faiths come to me for blessings, comfort, and guidance.
hint: My famous teaching is “Shraddha and Saburi,” meaning faith and patience.

title: Maa Kali
description: I have a dark complexion and a fierce expression, but I am a powerful protector who destroys evil and protects the innocent. My appearance may seem fearsome, but I represent the triumph of divine strength over darkness.
hint: My traditional images often show a garland of heads and an extended tongue.

title: Tara Devi
description: My golden appearance makes me stand out among the dolls. I represent compassion, protection, and hope, and this idol also carries a special connection to a monastery in Mangalore.
hint: My name means “star” in Sanskrit, and I am revered in Buddhist traditions.

title: Goddess Saraswati
description: I bless students, musicians, artists, and seekers of knowledge. Wherever learning, creativity, and wisdom flourish, my blessings are remembered.
hint: Look for my veena, white clothing, and often a swan.

title: Jagannath, Subhadra and Balram
description: Three beloved siblings stand together, each with a distinctive appearance and a special place in an important Indian pilgrimage tradition.
hint: Their famous temple and annual Rath Yatra are associated with Puri in Odisha.
answer: Lord Jagannath, Goddess Subhadra and Lord Balabhadra (Balaram)

title: Goddess Durga’s Face
description: Even without seeing my entire form, my powerful expression tells a story of courage, protection, and divine feminine strength.
hint: I am worshipped especially during Navaratri, and my face is often adorned with a red bindi and a crown.

title: Goddess Durga Killing Mahishasura
description: A mighty demon believed himself invincible. But a powerful goddess appeared to battle him and restore balance to the world.
hint: The demon I defeat is often depicted as a buffalo or a figure emerging from one.

title: LEGO Ganesha
description: An ancient symbol of wisdom meets the modern world of tiny interlocking bricks. I may be built one brick at a time, but my blessings are timeless!
hint: I still have an elephant’s head, even though I am made of LEGO.

title: Ram Mandir, Ayodhya
description: This magnificent temple is dedicated to Lord Rama and stands in a city deeply connected to his life story.
hint: The city it's in is believed to be Lord Rama's birthplace.

title: The Sacred Tulsi Plant
description: I may be a small plant, but I hold a special place in many Indian homes. I am nurtured with care and associated with purity, devotion, and daily prayers.
hint: My leaves are often offered in worship to Lord Vishnu and Krishna.

title: The Ten Avatars
description: When the world needs protection and balance, the divine takes different forms across the ages. Together, these ten incarnations tell a remarkable story of restoring dharma.
hint: The sequence traditionally begins with a fish and includes a tortoise, a boar, and a half-man, half-lion.
answer: Dashavatara — the ten avatars of Lord Vishnu

title: Ten LEGO Mandalorians
description: Ten mysterious warriors stand ready for action. They follow a strict code, wear distinctive armor, and belong to a galaxy far, far away.
hint: Their creed includes the words “This is the Way.”

title: The Fruit Vendor
description: Here is a little slice of everyday life: a hardworking couple, fresh produce, and a kitchen in the background. Together, they capture the charm of a traditional marketplace and home.
hint: One of them sells the colorful goodies that make a fruit salad delicious.

title: The Japanese Doll
description: Dressed in beautiful traditional clothing, I reflect the elegance and artistry of a culture known for its graceful customs and attention to detail.
hint: Think kimono, delicate craftsmanship, and the Land of the Rising Sun.

title: The Greek Doll
description: I bring a little Mediterranean charm to the Golu. My homeland is known for ancient temples, myths of gods and heroes, blue seas, and delicious food.
hint: Think Athens, the Acropolis, and the land of Zeus.

title: The Mexican Corn-Husk Doll
description: I am crafted from a humble natural material and celebrate the creativity of traditional folk art. My appearance connects me to handmade crafts and cultural heritage.
hint: The material I am made from is the outer covering of a staple crop used to make tortillas.

title: The Bullock Cart
description: Before cars and delivery trucks took over the roads, I helped carry people, crops, and goods. I am a reminder of a time when travel moved at the pace of animals.
hint: Two sturdy animals pull me, and farmers once relied on me every day.

title: The Horse Carriage
description: Before modern taxis and cars, I offered a stylish way to travel through town. With wheels, a carriage, and a powerful animal up front, I was once a familiar sight on the roads.
hint: Cinderella famously rode in a magical version of me.

title: The LEGO Harry Potter Book Set
description: A world of spells, magical creatures, and wizarding adventures comes alive through a construction toy inspired by a beloved fantasy series.
hint: My hero has a lightning-shaped scar and attends Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

title: The Golu Steps Made with LEGO
description: Even the stage holding this Golu has a story of its own! Instead of relying only on traditional materials, these steps bring two imaginative worlds together in an unexpected way.
hint: Look for a miniature model of the steps.
answer: Golu steps built with Harry Potter and Star Wars LEGO

title: LEGO Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: A Lego set depicting a superhero battle.
hint: This was inspired by a recent superhero movie that became one of the highest grossing movies of all time.
answer: LEGO Spider-Man scene inspired by Brand New Day

title: The New Orleans Jazz Musician
description: My music brings a lively city to life. With rhythm, improvisation, and a little swing, I help create a sound that has travelled around the world.
hint: Think brass bands, the French Quarter, and the birthplace of jazz in Louisiana.

title: The Pink Batgirl LEGO
description: I am normally a dark and brooding superhero but today I am wearing a pink tutu.
hint: I am associated with Gotham City and am a lego

title: The Madagascar Lemur
description: I am a curious creature with expressive eyes and a distinctive tail. I come from an island with wildlife found nowhere else in the world.
hint: Think of King Julien and his famous dance from the Madagascar movie.

title: The Costa Rican Sloth
description: I take life slowly, spend much of my time in trees, and make a virtue of doing everything at my own pace. My home is a tropical paradise full of rainforests and wildlife.
hint: “Pura vida” is a famous expression in the country I call home.

title: The School with a Math Lesson
description: In this little world, students gather, a lesson is underway, and young minds are busy learning. It captures the familiar sights and sounds of a classroom.
hint: The teacher may ask you to solve an equation rather than memorize a myth!
answer: School scene with a mathematics lesson

title: The Singapore Merlion
description: I am a creature that combines two symbols of a modern island nation. I stand proudly as a reminder of its maritime roots and its identity as a major city.
hint: My head is a lion, my body is a fish, and I am a famous Singapore landmark.

title: The Mexican Mariachi Band
description: We bring a festive spirit wherever we go, with lively melodies, colorful traditional outfits, and music that celebrates love, family, and community.
hint: Our sound often features trumpets, string instruments, and the traditional charro suit.

title: Grandpa and Grandma— The Merchant Couple
description: This traditional couple represents the world of trade and commerce. With their familiar attire and businesslike presence, they bring a charming slice of old-time Indian life to the Golu.
hint: They are a grandfather and grandmother couple.

title: The Wooden Couple — A Family Heirloom
description: I have stood the test of time, carrying memories across generations. Unlike a newly purchased decoration, my value lies in the family stories and traditions I represent.
hint: I am made of wood, and my place in this Golu connects past generations with the present.

title: The Dancers
description: Through movement, rhythm, and expression, we tell stories without needing words. Our poses capture the joy of performance and the beauty of artistic traditions.
hint: Our art form can turn music into a story told through the body.

title: The Turkish Whirling Dervish
description: I spin gracefully in a meditative dance that represents a spiritual journey. My flowing robes and circular movements create a mesmerizing sight.
hint: My traditional ceremony is associated with the Mevlevi Sufi order and the poet Rumi.

title: The Knights
description: Clad in armor and carrying weapons, we belong to an age of castles, kings, and quests. Our stories are filled with courage, loyalty, and battles for honor.
hint: Think medieval Europe, swords, shields, and the legend of King Arthur.

title: The Wooden Musicians
description: Though carved from wood, we seem ready to fill the room with music. Our instruments and poses celebrate the timeless joy of making melodies together.
hint: Look at the instruments we hold to discover what kind of musical ensemble we represent.

title: The Xochimilco Boat, Batman and Joker
description: A little bit of Mexico meets Gotham City! One figure represents a famous traditional boat ride, while two superheroes are ready for action. Can you identify this unusual combination?
hint: The colorful boats are found in Mexico City, Batman rides on one, while chasing the Joker.
answer: Xochimilco boat, Batman and Joker on a scooter
